text: My office heard from residents on Balsam Avenue, between Beech Avenue and Willow Avenue, that finding parking during the day has become difficult since the opening of the new YMCA on Kingston Road. To improve parking aspects for residents, I recommend adding a 1-hour limit, daily, on this portion of Balsam to increase vehicle turnover in the area.

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Authorized parking for a maximum period of one hour from 9:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m., daily, on the east side of Balsam Avenue, between Beech Avenue and Willow Avenue.
